caption: The drawing depicts a round, wooden object that appears to be a lid or cover with a semi-circular, articulated section attached to the upper right portion, suggesting it can be rotated or lifted. The object is mostly a light brown color, representing a wood grain texture, with faint hints of red and green. The central circular section features a symmetrical, leaf-like ornamental design that is outlined with darker lines and contains a decorative motif within. Two metallic hinges or brackets are visible horizontally across the central axis, rendered in muted brownish-gold tones. The articulated upper section has a scalloped, gilded border pattern. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and a small handwritten inscription is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Baptismal Font
